detail: N.J.A.C. 11:4-11.3(a)1 says that with an unconditional refund provision of at least 10 days, the Buyer's Guide may be delivered with the policy or before delivery. 'Latest point' then points to C. A is the general rule when there is no such provision, so the 10-day fact in the stem rules it out.
exact source quote and cited explanation
picked "Not allowed, as unfair discrimination based on the source of funds"

The source is categorical: a policy shall not provide credits for a surrender charge imposed under another contract, because such credits unfairly discriminate based on the source of funding. No disclosure exception exists, so C does not hold up.

Mild cue: A is the only option that gives a specific, regulatory-sounding rationale ('unfair discrimination based on the source of funds') that matches the source's wording. Calling D's absolute 'surrender charges are illegal' wrong is common sense. A testwise candidate can narrow it to A or C without knowing the rule, but still needs the rule to reject C.
